verdict_scope: Power Semiconductor quality parity with the STI Golden Example
verdict_reason: Order 141 proves governed end-to-end transport, but overview-only evidence does not support an investment-reviewable value chain, causal assessment, or link-expansion loop.

scoring.relative_formula: power_score / sti_score * 100; N/A when STI score is zero or evidence is not comparable

rubric.basis: STI uses filings, earnings-call/issuer commentary, five-quarter financials, inventory, segment/product revenue, and capacity evidence for three representative companies. Power Semi has five company_overview documents only; filings, calls, and time series are absent.

Both cases preserve sources and pending epistemic status. STI covers each causal field with source, evidence, confidence, and counter-evidence. Power Semi has hashed provenance for all five identities but leaves all four thesis questions pending.

STI links demand, test process, products/components, constraints, and earnings conversion. Power Semi contains a bootstrap ValueChain plus five candidate memberships; initial nodes, links, and analytical slots remain empty.

STI has three evidence-bearing driver/bottleneck/beneficiary chains with falsifiers. Power Semi assertions are an empty array and the review explicitly defers bottleneck, beneficiary, and causal claims.
STI records connected frontiers, source-needed fields, rechecks, and strengthen/weaken decisions. Power Semi has only a planned link-expansion question and an empty frontier.

Fresh read-back: 358 nodes/378 relationships globally; STI has 11 sourced HBM exposure edges and three pending WinWay CausalAssertions, but the full three-company structured chain is not live. Power Semi has five companies, five Evidence nodes, and five candidate/pending memberships with status exposed as status; it has no semantic or causal chain.

human_review_readiness.sti: structured pending review; representative loop reviewable
human_review_readiness.power_semi: identity/membership reviewable only; 4 analytical questions pending

gap_matrix.element: connected link-expansion frontier with recheck decision
single deterministic NEW-to-write artifact chain with hashed evidence and explicit write manifest
all five seeds resolved and written as governed candidate memberships in one run

root_cause_summary.factory_contract: The full-path executor stops KE at candidate identity and has no contract output for causal records, counter-evidence, expansion decisions, or review packets beyond membership.
root_cause_summary.evidence_depth: Order 141 executed only company_overview sources although the Source Plan named SEC, company IR, and earnings calls.
root_cause_summary.test_case_difference: STI is a matured multi-order Golden Example; Power Semi is a first cold-start five-seed run. This explains some absolute gap but does not make missing decision fields N/A because both cases ask the same investment questions.

top_3_priorities.priority: Make question coverage an execution/stop gate
top_3_priorities.minimum_change: For each thesis question, require at least one primary-source evidence item or an explicit blocked result before KE/review can pass.
top_3_priorities.expected_effect: Prevents identity-only runs from being labeled quality-complete.

top_3_priorities.priority: Emit one governed causal review record per supported chain
top_3_priorities.minimum_change: Reuse the existing IVK v2 driver/bottleneck/beneficiary fields, including counter-evidence, confidence, epistemic status, and review status; do not require live graph confirmation.
top_3_priorities.expected_effect: Turns collected evidence into investment-reviewable structure without expanding write scope.

top_3_priorities.minimum_change: Select one connected frontier, state source needed, re-read a primary source, and record strengthen/weaken/reject.
top_3_priorities.expected_effect: Proves the discovery loop rather than only linear stage transport.

follow_up_material: power equipment versus generation versus semiconductor role taxonomy
AI data-center power path vocabulary from utility/grid through distribution, UPS, conversion, and load

limitations: STI evidence is distributed across Orders 127-132 and is not one cold-start run.
The STI live graph contains only the WinWay causal pilot; the richer three-company chains remain structured artifacts.
No external source refresh or Neo4j write was performed for this benchmark.
Scores are anchored ordinal quality judgments, not statistical estimates.
